# MBTI Cognitive Function Test

> A free 38-item cognitive-function MBTI test (EI / SN / TF / JP plus an A-T turbulence axis) that runs entirely in the browser. Any LLM or agent can take it through static GET endpoints only: no API key, no backend, no rate limit. Entertainment-grade self-assessment, not a clinical or diagnostic instrument.

## For AI agents
- [Agent index](https://3310zx.github.io/mbti-test/ai/llms.txt): machine-facing index of everything under /ai/.
- [Specification](https://3310zx.github.io/mbti-test/ai/spec.md): authoritative scale, 38 questions, scoring algorithm, JSON schema, answer modes and a copy-paste agent prompt.
- [Questions JSON](https://3310zx.github.io/mbti-test/ai/questions.json): all 38 items with id, dimension, direction and English/Chinese text.
- [Score endpoint](https://3310zx.github.io/mbti-test/ai/score.html): GET ?a=3,2,5,... with 38 integers 1-6 (comma or dash separated) and receive the result JSON.
- [Result profiles](https://3310zx.github.io/mbti-test/ai/result/intj.json): 16 static per-type JSON files (e.g. intj.json, enfp.json) with stack, names and descriptions.
- [Agent card](https://3310zx.github.io/mbti-test/agent-card.json): minimal A2A-style capability declaration for the mbti-test skill.
